study type: Descriptive analysis and multivariate logit analysis
cohort: Women in North-East India seeking obstetric and gynecological surgical procedures
finding: Surgical rates for essential obstetric and gynecological procedures in North-East India vary substantially based on service capacity, socioeconomic status, and travel times to facilities, highlighting the importance of demand-side factors in accessing surgical care.
mod_finding: Travel times to surgical facilities are associated with rates of caesarean section and hysterectomy but not sterilisation where services are much more deconcentrated.
